words.enDefinition: a part-time teacher hired per course without tenure

examples.en: Our writing seminar is taught by an adjunct professor from a publishing house.
examples.zh: 我们的写作课由出版业内的一位「兼职教授」来教。

examples.en: Adjunct professors usually hold office hours right before or after class.
examples.zh: 「兼职教授」一般只在课前课后短时间答疑。

words.enDefinition: the part-time teaching staff of a department collectively

examples.en: Most intro sections here are taught by adjunct faculty on yearly contracts.
examples.zh: 这里大多数导论课由按年签约的「兼职师资」承担。

examples.en: The department relies on adjunct faculty to cover evening classes.
examples.zh: 晚间课程主要依靠「兼职师资」来支撑。

words.enDefinition: a junior tenure-track rank below associate professor

examples.en: Professor Lee joined us as an assistant professor straight after her postdoc.
examples.zh: 李教授博士后出站后直接受聘为「助理教授」。

examples.en: Assistant professors often carry heavier teaching loads while seeking tenure.
examples.zh: 「助理教授」在争取终身教职时授课任务往往更重。

words.enDefinition: a mid-level faculty rank, usually already tenured

examples.en: She was promoted to associate professor the year her book appeared.
examples.zh: 新书出版那年，她晋升为「副教授」。

examples.en: Ask an associate professor how the tenure process really works.
examples.zh: 不妨问问「副教授」，终身教职评审究竟怎么回事。

words.enDefinition: the highest regular faculty rank above associate professor

examples.en: After twenty years of research, she finally made full professor last spring.
examples.zh: 潜心研究二十年后，她终于在去年春天升上「正教授」。

examples.en: Full professors often lead the research groups everyone wants to join.
examples.zh: 「正教授」往往领导着人人想进的课题组。

collocations: reach the rank of full professor

words.enDefinition: a professor with a permanent contract that is hard to end

examples.en: A tenured professor cannot be fired just for unpopular research views.
examples.zh: 「终身教授」不会因研究观点不受欢迎而被解雇。

examples.en: Tenured professors sometimes teach the odd elective nobody else wants.
examples.zh: 有些冷门选修课只有「终身教授」愿意教。

words.enDefinition: a permanent-track job leading to a tenure review

examples.en: She accepted a tenure-track position right after finishing her postdoc.
examples.zh: 博士后一结束，她就接受了「终身教职轨道」的岗位。

examples.en: Tenure-track faculty usually teach fewer courses than adjunct instructors do.
examples.zh: 「终身教职轨道」的教师课时通常比兼职讲师少。

words.enDefinition: a teaching-focused professor hired for professional experience

examples.en: Our patent law course is taught by a clinical professor with twenty years of practice.
examples.zh: 我们的专利法课由执业二十年的「实务教授」讲授。

examples.en: Clinical professors usually focus on teaching rather than publishing research.
examples.zh: 「实务教授」通常侧重教学而非发表论文。

words.enDefinition: an honorary title for a small number of top faculty

examples.en: Only three faculty members in the whole university hold the distinguished professor title.
examples.zh: 全校只有三位教师拥有「杰出教授」头衔。

examples.en: The distinguished professor still teaches one freshman seminar every year.
examples.zh: 这位「杰出教授」每年仍教一门大一研讨课。

collocations: hold the rank of distinguished professor

words.enDefinition: a professor temporarily teaching at another university

examples.en: A visiting professor from Oxford teaches our semantics course this term.
examples.zh: 本学期的语义学由牛津来的「客座教授」讲授。

examples.en: Visiting professors usually stay for only one or two semesters.
examples.zh: 「客座教授」通常只停留一到两个学期。

words.enDefinition: a researcher staying temporarily to do research at a university

examples.en: My supervisor is hosting a visiting scholar from Tsinghua this year.
examples.zh: 我的导师今年接待了一位清华来的「访问学者」。

examples.en: Visiting scholars can use the library just like regular faculty.
examples.zh: 「访问学者」可以像正式教师一样使用图书馆。

words.enDefinition: a retired professor who keeps an honorary title

examples.en: Professor Wright is professor emeritus now but still attends every department seminar.
examples.zh: 赖特教授如今是「荣休教授」，系里研讨仍场场必到。

examples.en: The professor emeritus still advises a couple of doctoral students.
examples.zh: 这位「荣休教授」仍在指导两名博士生。

words.enDefinition: an experienced teaching-focused rank below professor

examples.en: Senior lecturers here carry most of the first-year teaching load.
examples.zh: 这里大一的授课大多落在「高级讲师」身上。

examples.en: Our senior lecturer also runs the department's weekly writing clinic.
examples.zh: 我们系的「高级讲师」还主持每周写作辅导。

words.enDefinition: younger professors early in their academic careers

examples.en: Junior faculty often get assigned the eight a.m. introductory courses.
examples.zh: 早上八点的导论课常常派给「初级教员」。

examples.en: The mentoring program pairs junior faculty members with senior professors.
examples.zh: 导师计划把「初级教员」与资深教授配对。

words.enDefinition: long-serving professors with the highest ranks

examples.en: Senior faculty teach the advanced seminars and supervise most theses.
examples.zh: 高阶研讨课和大多数论文都由「资深教员」负责。

examples.en: Senior faculty members vote on the department's new course proposals.
examples.zh: 新课程提案由「资深教员」投票表决。

words.enDefinition: a grad student or new PhD hired to teach a course

examples.en: Each section of the big lecture has a teaching fellow leading discussions.
examples.zh: 大课的每个小班都有一名「教学研究员」带讨论。

examples.en: Teaching fellows grade for the professor and hold weekly help sessions.
examples.zh: 「教学研究员」帮教授批改并主持每周答疑。

words.enDefinition: a grad student with full responsibility for a section

examples.en: As a graduate instructor, Maria teaches two discussion sections herself.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚作为「研究生讲师」，独立带两个讨论班。

examples.en: Graduate instructors receive formal teaching training before the semester starts.
examples.zh: 开学前「研究生讲师」要接受正式的教学培训。

words.enDefinition: a grad student assisting a professor with teaching duties

examples.en: The graduate teaching assistant runs the lab sessions and grades quizzes.
examples.zh: 「研究生助教」负责实验课并批改小测。

examples.en: Email the graduate teaching assistant first; she handles homework questions.
examples.zh: 作业问题先发邮件给「研究生助教」，由她答疑。

collocations: work as a graduate teaching assistant

words.enDefinition: a grad student paid to support teaching or admin work

examples.en: Graduate assistants at the department office answer student emails all day.
examples.zh: 系办的「研究生助理」整天回复学生邮件。

examples.en: As a graduate assistant, she gets free tuition and a small stipend.
examples.zh: 作为「研究生助理」，她免学费还能拿少量津贴。

words.enDefinition: an undergraduate trained to help peers in class

examples.en: Learning assistants circulate during the physics workshop to help groups.
examples.zh: 物理工作坊上，「学习助理」巡回为各小组答疑。

examples.en: Becoming a learning assistant earns credit and a small payment.
examples.zh: 担任「学习助理」既拿学分又有少量报酬。

words.enDefinition: a researcher on a fixed-term contract, often after a PhD

examples.en: Dr. Chen is a research fellow funded by a three-year grant.
examples.zh: 陈博士是由三年期经费资助的「研究员」。

examples.en: Research fellows share the big office with the postdocs down the hall.
examples.zh: 「研究员」与走廊尽头的博士后们合用大办公室。

words.enDefinition: a full-time staff researcher on a research project

examples.en: The lab's research associate manages the instruments and the datasets.
examples.zh: 实验室的「副研究员」管理仪器和数据集。

examples.en: Research associates at our lab usually hold one-year renewable contracts.
examples.zh: 我们实验室的「副研究员」一般签一年一续的合同。

words.enDefinition: the person who oversees daily work in a lab

examples.en: Ask the lab supervisor before using the centrifuge on your own.
examples.zh: 独自使用离心机前，要先问过「实验室主管」。

examples.en: Our lab supervisor checks everyone's safety goggles at the door.
examples.zh: 「实验室主管」会在门口检查每个人的护目镜。

words.enDefinition: a student helper who sets up lab equipment

examples.en: The lab assistant had already laid out the slides and beakers.
examples.zh: 「实验室助理」早已摆好了切片和烧杯。

examples.en: Lab assistants get safety training during the first week of term.
examples.zh: 「实验室助理」在开学第一周接受安全培训。

words.enDefinition: the staff member who runs a lab's operations and orders

examples.en: Email the lab manager if the pipette tips run out.
examples.zh: 移液枪吸头用完，就给「实验室管理员」发邮件。

examples.en: The lab manager keeps the chemical inventory up to date.
examples.zh: 「实验室管理员」负责及时更新化学品清单。

collocations: order supplies through the lab manager

words.enDefinition: the staff member who schedules and organizes lab courses

examples.en: The lab coordinator moved our chemistry session to Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 「实验课协调员」把我们的化学实验挪到了周四下午。

examples.en: Contact the lab coordinator about any experiments that you missed.
examples.zh: 错过了实验，就联系「实验课协调员」。

words.enDefinition: skilled staff who maintain instruments and prepare materials

examples.en: The lab technician calibrated the spectrometer before our morning session.
examples.zh: 上午实验开始前，「实验技术员」校准了光谱仪。

examples.en: Lab technicians wear the same safety goggles as the students do.
examples.zh: 「实验技术员」和学生一样要佩戴护目镜。

words.enDefinition: a student paid to help a professor with research

examples.en: As a research assistant, I clean datasets and run surveys for Professor Diaz.
examples.zh: 作为「研究助理」，我为迪亚兹教授清洗数据、发放问卷。

examples.en: Research assistants usually work ten hours a week for tuition support.
examples.zh: 「研究助理」通常每周工作十小时换取学费减免。

words.enDefinition: a student hired only to score homework and exams

examples.en: The department hired two graders for the four-hundred-student economics course.
examples.zh: 这门四百人的经济学课，系里雇了两名「批改员」。

examples.en: Graders must follow the professor's answer key closely when scoring.
examples.zh: 「批改员」打分必须严格依照教授的答案要点。

words.enDefinition: faculty employed full-time, usually with benefits

examples.en: Full-time faculty keep regular office hours, so email them anytime.
examples.zh: 「全职教师」有固定答疑时间，随时可以邮件联系。

examples.en: Only full-time faculty can supervise senior theses in our department.
examples.zh: 在我们系，只有「全职教师」能指导毕业论文。

words.enDefinition: not strict, especially about deadlines or grades

examples.en: Professor Ramos is lenient about deadlines, but learn the material well.
examples.zh: 拉莫斯教授对截止日期「要求宽松」，但你要真正学懂。

examples.en: Do not assume a lenient professor will write you a strong letter.
examples.zh: 别以为老师「要求宽松」就一定会给你写有力的推荐信。

words.enDefinition: a recent PhD doing further research on a temporary contract

examples.en: Our postdoc taught the morning section while Professor Lee was away.
examples.zh: 李教授外出期间，由「博士后」代讲上午的小班课。

examples.en: Postdocs usually stay two or three years before finding faculty jobs.
examples.zh: 「博士后」一般待两三年再去应聘教职。

words.enDefinition: the lead professor in charge of a research project

examples.en: The principal investigator announced the new grant at our lab meeting.
examples.zh: 「课题负责人」在组会上宣布了新经费到位。

examples.en: Undergrads email the principal investigator to ask about joining the lab.
examples.zh: 本科生想进组，就给「课题负责人」发邮件。

words.enDefinition: the number of courses a professor teaches each term

examples.en: Her teaching load is two courses plus one graduate seminar.
examples.zh: 她的「授课工作量」是两门课加一门研究生研讨课。

examples.en: Professors with heavy teaching loads hold fewer weekly office hours.
examples.zh: 「授课任务」重的教授，每周答疑时间也更少。

collocations: a teaching load of two courses

words.enDefinition: a professor's team of students and researchers

examples.en: Professor Okafor invited me to join her research group next term.
examples.zh: 奥卡福教授邀请我下学期加入她的「课题组」。

examples.en: The research group meets every Friday to discuss new papers.
examples.zh: 「课题组」每周五开会研讨新论文。

words.enDefinition: a regular team meeting to discuss lab research

examples.en: At lab meeting, each member presents one paper every week.
examples.zh: 在「组会」上，成员每周汇报一篇论文。

examples.en: Lab meetings run on Friday afternoons, and attendance is expected.
examples.zh: 「组会」定在周五下午，原则上人人都要参加。

words.enDefinition: funding awarded to professors for a research project

examples.en: Professor Haddad's new research grant pays for two student assistants.
examples.zh: 哈达德教授的新「科研经费」够雇两名学生助理。

examples.en: Undergraduate research jobs are often funded by a professor's research grant.
examples.zh: 本科生的科研岗位常常由教授的「科研经费」支付。

words.enDefinition: the world of universities, research, and professors

examples.en: After years in industry, she returned to academia for the research freedom.
examples.zh: 在企业工作多年后，她为了科研自由重返「学术界」。

examples.en: Academia moves slowly, so recommendation letters can take several weeks.
examples.zh: 「学术界」节奏偏慢，推荐信动辄要等几周。

words.enDefinition: a paid semester or year off for professors to research

examples.en: Professor Ito is on sabbatical this fall, so email her TA instead.
examples.zh: 伊藤教授本学期「学术休假」，有事请邮件联系她的助教。

examples.en: Sabbaticals let professors step away from teaching and finish their books.
examples.zh: 「学术休假」让教授暂离讲台，专心写书。

words.enDefinition: any professor, lecturer, or instructor at a university

examples.en: Every faculty member posts office hours on their office door.
examples.zh: 每位「教员」都会把答疑时间贴在办公室门上。

examples.en: All faculty members vote on the curriculum changes each spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，「教员们」都会就课程调整投票。

words.enDefinition: all the teaching staff of a university collectively

examples.en: The faculty voted to keep the pass-fail option for freshmen.
examples.zh: 「全体教师」投票决定大一继续保留及格制。

examples.en: Faculty are expected to reply to student emails within two days.
examples.zh: 学校要求「教师」两天内回复学生邮件。

words.enDefinition: a person employed by the university in a non-teaching job

examples.en: A staff member at the front desk can print your enrollment letter.
examples.zh: 前台的「工作人员」能帮你打印在读证明。

examples.en: Staff members wear lanyards so you can tell them apart from students.
examples.zh: 「工作人员」都挂着工牌，一眼就能和学生区分。

collocations: staff member at the front desk

words.enDefinition: employees who keep offices running, like assistants and clerks

examples.en: Support staff handle the photocopying, room scheduling, and form signatures.
examples.zh: 复印、订教室、表格签字都由「行政支持人员」办理。

examples.en: Thank the support staff during finals week; they are swamped.
examples.zh: 期末周也请感谢「行政支持人员」，他们忙得不可开交。

words.enDefinition: an experienced person who guides a student's growth

examples.en: Dr. Patel became my mentor during my first research project.
examples.zh: 在第一个科研项目中，帕特尔博士成了我的「良师」。

examples.en: Ask your mentor before switching out of the honors track.
examples.zh: 退出荣誉项目之前，先听听「良师」的意见。

words.enDefinition: a relationship where an experienced person guides a junior one

examples.en: Under Professor Romero's mentorship, my academic writing improved very fast.
examples.zh: 在罗梅罗教授的「悉心指导」下，我的学术写作进步飞快。

examples.en: The department offers a formal mentorship program for first-year students.
examples.zh: 系里为大一新生设有正式的「师长指导」项目。

words.enDefinition: a senior student who guides new students

examples.en: My peer mentor showed me how to email professors properly.
examples.zh: 我的「同伴导师」教我怎么得体地给教授写邮件。

examples.en: Peer mentors live in the same dorm as their first-year group.
examples.zh: 「同伴导师」和自己带的大一组住在同一栋宿舍。

words.enDefinition: to oversee a student's research or a team's work

examples.en: Professor Weiss supervises six thesis students during this academic year.
examples.zh: 韦斯教授本学年「指导」六名写论文的学生。

examples.en: During experiments, each lab supervisor also supervises the undergraduate students.
examples.zh: 实验期间，「实验室主管」还要监督本科生操作。

words.enDefinition: to score students' essays and problem sets

examples.en: Professor Osei spends her Sundays grading papers for two sections.
examples.zh: 奥塞教授每周日都在给两个班「批改作业」。

examples.en: TAs grade papers within a week so the feedback stays useful.
examples.zh: 助教一周内「批改完作业」，反馈才有时效。

words.enDefinition: to present research to an audience

examples.en: Professor Amari will give a talk on memory models this Friday.
examples.zh: 阿玛丽教授本周五将「做讲座」，主题是记忆模型。

examples.en: Practice several times before you give a talk at a conference.
examples.zh: 在会议上「做报告」之前，一定要多练几遍。

collocations: invite someone to give a talk

words.enDefinition: a prize recognizing excellent university teaching

examples.en: Professor Duval has won the university's top teaching award twice.
examples.zh: 杜瓦尔教授两度获得校级「教学奖」。

examples.en: Students nominate their professors for the teaching award every April.
examples.zh: 每年四月，学生都可以提名「教学奖」人选。

collocations: nominate a professor for a teaching award

words.enDefinition: someone who shares your office or desk space

examples.en: My office mate is a fourth-year PhD student in economics.
examples.zh: 我的「办公室室友」是经济学四年级博士生。

examples.en: Office mates share a printer and take turns buying coffee.
examples.zh: 「办公室室友」共用打印机，还轮流买咖啡。

collocations: share an office with an office mate

words.enDefinition: students who start a program in the same year

examples.en: My cohort has eleven students, and we take every class together.
examples.zh: 我们「同届」有十一个人，每门课都一起上。

examples.en: Each cohort chooses one representative for the department's monthly meetings.
examples.zh: 每届「同届学生」要选出一名代表参加系务会议。

words.enDefinition: a regular one-on-one meeting with your thesis supervisor

examples.en: Bring a short written agenda to each of your supervision meetings.
examples.zh: 每次「导师面谈」都带一份简短书面提纲。

examples.en: My supervision meetings have moved from Tuesday mornings to Thursdays.
examples.zh: 我的「导师面谈」从周二上午改到了周四。

words.enDefinition: a senior official who leads a college or school

examples.en: The dean approved our class trip to the state archive.
examples.zh: 「院长」批准了我们去州档案馆的班级参访。

examples.en: Complaints about a grade can be escalated to the dean.
examples.zh: 对成绩有异议，可以升级提交给「院长」。

words.enDefinition: a dean's deputy handling a specific area

examples.en: The associate dean handles student conduct cases for our college.
examples.zh: 我们学院的「副院长」负责学生纪律事务。

examples.en: Send the appeal to the associate dean if the professor declines.
examples.zh: 教授不同意的话，就把申请发给「副院长」。

words.enDefinition: a junior dean supporting college administration

examples.en: The assistant dean manages all of the college's scholarship budgets.
examples.zh: 「院长助理」管理学院的奖学金预算。

examples.en: Ask the assistant dean about any late graduation request forms.
examples.zh: 延迟毕业的申请要找「院长助理」。

words.enDefinition: the top leader of a whole American university

examples.en: The university president opens commencement with a short welcome speech.
examples.zh: 「大学校长」会在毕业典礼上简短致辞。

examples.en: Students rarely meet the university president outside of big ceremonies.
examples.zh: 除了大型典礼，学生很少能见到这位「校长」。

collocations: welcome speech by the university president

words.enDefinition: the chief executive of a UK or Commonwealth university

examples.en: In Australia, the vice chancellor is the head of the university.
examples.zh: 在澳大利亚，「英联邦大学校长」是大学的最高负责人。

examples.en: The vice chancellor announced several new scholarships for international students.
examples.zh: 这位「英联邦大学校长」宣布为国际学生增设奖学金。

words.enDefinition: a department chair's deputy for scheduling or advising

examples.en: The associate chair resolves schedule conflicts within the whole department.
examples.zh: 系内排课冲突由「副系主任」处理。

examples.en: Bring your course plan to the associate chair for approval.
examples.zh: 选课计划要拿给「副系主任」审批。

words.enDefinition: the governing board that oversees a university

examples.en: The board of trustees voted to freeze tuition for next year.
examples.zh: 「校董会」投票决定明年冻结学费。

examples.en: Decisions about tuition never rest with professors but with the board of trustees.
examples.zh: 学费的决定权在「校董会」而不是教授手里。

collocations: voted by the board of trustees
member of the board of trustees

words.enDefinition: the elected body where professors govern academic matters

examples.en: The faculty senate debated the new AI policy for months.
examples.zh: 「教授评议会」就新的人工智能政策争论了几个月。

examples.en: Any course requirement changes need the faculty senate's approval first.
examples.zh: 课程要求若有修改，须先经「教授评议会」批准。

words.enDefinition: a panel that interviews candidates for a faculty job

examples.en: The search committee invited three candidates to give job talks.
examples.zh: 「招聘委员会」邀请了三位候选人来做求职讲座。

examples.en: Grad students can attend the open sessions with the search committee.
examples.zh: 研究生可以参加与「招聘委员会」的公开见面环节。

words.enDefinition: the staff member who administers a multi-section course

examples.en: Email the course coordinator if you want to switch sections.
examples.zh: 想换讨论班，就给「课程协调员」发邮件。

examples.en: The course coordinator collects every make-up exam request from students.
examples.zh: 学生的补考申请统一由「课程协调员」收取。

words.enDefinition: the staff member who manages a degree program's paperwork

examples.en: The program coordinator signed off on all my transfer credits.
examples.zh: 「项目协调员」批准了我的全部转学分。

examples.en: Program coordinators answer the questions that professors won't, like deadlines.
examples.zh: 像截止日期这类问题，教授不管，都问「项目协调员」。

words.enDefinition: the professor who oversees an academic program

examples.en: The program director approved my proposal for an independent study.
examples.zh: 「项目主任」批准了我的独立研究申请。

examples.en: Direct any complaints about the curriculum to the program director.
examples.zh: 对课程设置的意见请反映给「项目主任」。

words.enDefinition: the staff member handling undergraduate course issues

examples.en: The undergraduate coordinator resolved my registration hold early this morning.
examples.zh: 「本科生事务协调员」一早帮我解除了选课冻结。

examples.en: The undergraduate coordinators know all the exception policies by heart.
examples.zh: 「本科生事务协调员」对各种例外政策了如指掌。

words.enDefinition: the staff member who manages a department office's schedules

examples.en: The office coordinator booked the seminar room for our review session.
examples.zh: 「办公室协调员」为复习课订好了研讨室。

examples.en: Direct all room-booking questions to the office coordinator by email.
examples.zh: 订教室的问题请一律邮件联系「办公室协调员」。

words.enDefinition: the staff manager who runs a department's daily operations

examples.en: The department administrator ordered new chairs for the staff lounge.
examples.zh: 「系行政主管」为教师休息室添置了新椅子。

examples.en: Budget questions go to the department administrator, not the professors.
examples.zh: 经费问题找「系行政主管」，别去麻烦教授。

words.enDefinition: the officer who collects tuition and fees

examples.en: The bursar's office emailed me about the unpaid lab fee.
examples.zh: 「财务主管」办公室来信提醒我补交实验费。

examples.en: Set up a payment plan through the bursar before the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止日前，在「财务主管」处办好分期付款。

collocations: a payment plan with the bursar

words.enDefinition: a professor who sets and marks an examination

examples.en: The examiner read every single essay twice before finalizing grades.
examples.zh: 「考官」每篇论文都读了两遍才定分。

examples.en: One examiner asks the questions while the other takes notes.
examples.zh: 一位「考官」提问，另一位负责记录。

words.enDefinition: A supervisor who shares responsibility with another supervisor for guiding a student's research.

examples.en: My co-supervisor reviewed the survey questions before I discussed them with my main adviser.
examples.zh: 我和主导师讨论调查问题之前，「共同指导导师」已经审阅了这些问题。

examples.en: The department assigned a co-supervisor who had experience with the methods I planned to use.
examples.zh: 院系为我安排了一位「共同指导导师」，熟悉我计划使用的方法。

words.enDefinition: a short written message thanking someone

examples.en: Send a thank-you note after a professor writes your recommendation.
examples.zh: 教授写完推荐信后，记得送一张「致谢便条」。

examples.en: A handwritten thank-you note stands out more than an email.
examples.zh: 手写的「致谢便条」比邮件更显心意。

collocations: a thank-you note to the professor

words.enDefinition: a brief question asked politely of a busy person

examples.en: Professor, do you have a minute for a quick question?
examples.zh: 教授，能占一分钟问个「小问题」吗？

examples.en: I emailed a quick question instead of waiting for office hours.
examples.zh: 我没等答疑时间，直接邮件问了个「小问题」。

words.enDefinition: to explain something step by step

examples.en: Could you walk me through the proof from yesterday's lecture?
examples.zh: 能「一步步讲解」一下昨天课上的证明吗？

examples.en: The registrar walked me through the transfer process on the phone.
examples.zh: 注册办在电话里「一步步指导」我办转学手续。

collocations: walk me through step by step

words.enDefinition: to tap on an office door before entering

examples.en: Always knock on the door, even when office hours have started.
examples.zh: 即使答疑时间已经开始，也要先「敲门」。

examples.en: She knocked on the door and waited for a Come in.
examples.zh: 她「敲了敲门」，等着里面喊请进。

words.enDefinition: a welcome to drop in without an appointment

examples.en: Professor Reyes keeps an open-door policy throughout the exam weeks.
examples.zh: 整个考试周，雷耶斯教授都实行「开门政策」。

examples.en: An open-door policy means you can drop by without emailing first.
examples.zh: 所谓「开门政策」，就是不用先发邮件，随时可以去找。

words.enDefinition: a professor's request to talk privately after a lecture

examples.en: If your quiz score worries you, see me after class.
examples.zh: 小测成绩让你担心的话，「课后来找我」。

examples.en: See me after class and we'll sort out your enrollment error.
examples.zh: 「课后来找我」，咱们一起把选课错误改掉。

collocations: asked to see me after class
see me after class on Friday

words.enDefinition: a professor's invitation to meet in their office

examples.en: Come to my office and we'll go over your essay outline.
examples.zh: 「来我办公室」，我们一起过一遍论文提纲。

examples.en: If my office hours don't work, come to my office another afternoon.
examples.zh: 答疑时间不合适，就改天下午「来我办公室」。

collocations: feel free to come to my office
come to my office before the deadline

words.enDefinition: a question asking if a professor is available

examples.en: Excuse me, is the professor in? I have a three o'clock meeting.
examples.zh: 请问「教授在办公室吗」？我约了三点的面谈。

examples.en: Knock softly and ask, is the professor in for office hours?
examples.zh: 进门前轻声问「教授在吗」，确认是否正在答疑。

collocations: ask if the professor is in
check whether the professor is in

words.enDefinition: a polite closing after someone helps you

examples.en: Thank you for your time, Professor — I'll revise the draft tonight.
examples.zh: 「感谢您抽时间」，教授，我今晚就改好草稿。

examples.en: She closed her email with thank you for your time and consideration.
examples.zh: 她在邮件结尾写上「感谢您抽时间」，并请教授斟酌。

collocations: thank you for your time and consideration
thank the professor for the meeting

words.enDefinition: only at an arranged time, not walk-in

examples.en: Professor Kim sees students by appointment during the grading season.
examples.zh: 阅卷期间，金教授「需预约」才能见面。

examples.en: You can meet the associate dean by appointment on Friday afternoons.
examples.zh: 周五下午可「预约」会见副院长。

words.enDefinition: walk-ins welcome without booking ahead

examples.en: Her office hours are no appointment needed, so just drop in.
examples.zh: 她的答疑时间「无需预约」，直接去就行。

examples.en: The sign on the door says no appointment needed before the midterm.
examples.zh: 门上告示写着期中考前「无需预约」。

collocations: no appointment needed for office hours

words.enDefinition: calling each other by first names, not titles

examples.en: After two semesters, I'm on a first-name basis with my calculus professor.
examples.zh: 两个学期下来，我和微积分教授已经「直呼其名」了。

examples.en: American professors often put students on a first-name basis immediately.
examples.zh: 美国教授常常一开始就让学生「直呼其名」。

words.enDefinition: the family name used with a title like Professor

examples.en: Address Professor Osei by her last name unless she invites otherwise.
examples.zh: 称呼奥塞教授要用「姓氏」，除非她另有表示。

examples.en: Write your last name on every page of the exam paper.
examples.zh: 考卷每一页都要写上你的「姓氏」。

words.enDefinition: physically present rather than by phone or email

examples.en: Ask for the recommendation in person rather than over email.
examples.zh: 请求推荐这类事最好「当面」开口，别只发邮件。

examples.en: The professor explained the formula to me in person at office hours.
examples.zh: 教授在答疑时「当面」给我讲解了那个公式。

words.enDefinition: to request guidance from someone experienced

examples.en: Ask for advice early instead of guessing what the professor wants.
examples.zh: 与其猜教授的想法，不如早点「请教」。

examples.en: Students often ask for advice on narrowing their thesis topics.
examples.zh: 学生常就缩小论文选题一事「请教建议」。

collocations: ask for advice on the topic
ask for advice during office hours

words.enDefinition: to confirm something with the person in charge

examples.en: Check with the department office before assuming the deadline moved.
examples.zh: 别急着以为截止日期变了，先和系办「问清楚」。

examples.en: Check with your supervisor before you book any conference travel.
examples.zh: 订参会行程之前，先「问过」导师。

words.enDefinition: A list on which students reserve time to meet a teacher during office hours.

examples.en: I put my name on the office-hour sign-up sheet and picked the slot after lunch.
examples.zh: 我在「答疑时段登记表」上填了名字，选了午饭后的时段。

examples.en: The professor added two extra slots to the office-hour sign-up sheet before the assignment deadline.
examples.zh: 老师在作业截止前给「答疑时段登记表」增加了两个空档。

collocations: slot on the office-hour sign-up sheet

words.enDefinition: a friendly, trusting relationship built over time

examples.en: Office hours are a good way to build rapport with your professors.
examples.zh: 多去答疑是和教授建立「融洽关系」的好办法。

examples.en: Her rapport with students makes even hard lectures easy to follow.
examples.zh: 她与学生的「默契」让再难的课也容易跟上。

collocations: a good rapport with the professor

words.enDefinition: a searchable list of university employees and contacts

examples.en: Find your professor's email address in the campus staff directory.
examples.zh: 在校园「教职工名录」里查教授的邮箱。

examples.en: The staff directory lists every professor's office and phone extension.
examples.zh: 「教职工名录」列出了每位教授的办公室和分机。

words.enDefinition: a short internal number for an office phone

examples.en: The professor's phone extension is printed on the course syllabus.
examples.zh: 教授的「电话分机号」印在课程大纲上。

examples.en: Dial the main office and ask for the phone extension of Professor Lee.
examples.zh: 先拨总机，再请对方转「电话分机」找李教授。

words.enDefinition: the landline in a professor's or office room

examples.en: Call the office phone if your email gets no reply for days.
examples.zh: 邮件几天没回，就打「办公电话」。

examples.en: Her office phone goes straight to voicemail during her lectures.
examples.zh: 她上课时段，「办公电话」直接转语音信箱。

words.enDefinition: the building and room where someone works

examples.en: The syllabus lists the professor's office location and weekly hours.
examples.zh: 课程大纲写明了教授的「办公室位置」和每周答疑时间。

examples.en: Her office location moved to the fourth floor of Aldrich Hall.
examples.zh: 她的「办公室位置」改到了阿尔德里奇楼四层。

words.enDefinition: the door of a professor's office, often with notices

examples.en: Office hours are usually posted on the professor's office door.
examples.zh: 教授的「办公室门」上通常贴着答疑时间。

examples.en: A sign on her office door says back in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 她的「办公室门」上挂着字条：十分钟后回来。

words.enDefinition: a student survey rating a course and professor

examples.en: Please fill out the course evaluation before the Friday deadline.
examples.zh: 请在周五截止前填写「课程评教」。

examples.en: Professors read the course evaluations when they plan next term.
examples.zh: 教授规划下学期课程时会参考「课程评教」。

words.enDefinition: a list where visitors write their names

examples.en: Write your name on the sign-in sheet at the department office.
examples.zh: 到系办在「签到表」上写下名字。

examples.en: Attendance at the review session is tracked with a sign-in sheet.
examples.zh: 复习课用「签到表」记录出勤。

collocations: sign-in sheet at the front desk

words.enDefinition: the way a professor runs classes and explains ideas

examples.en: Her teaching style mixes short lectures with group problem-solving tasks.
examples.zh: 她的「教学风格」是短讲加小组解题。

examples.en: Ask older students about a professor's teaching style before enrolling.
examples.zh: 选课前先向学长打听教授的「教学风格」。

words.enDefinition: to build a relationship with your instructors

examples.en: Get to know your professor early; you'll need letters later.
examples.zh: 早点和教授多「交流」，以后写推荐信用得上。

examples.en: Office hours are the easiest way to get to know your professor.
examples.zh: 答疑时间是「多与教授交流」的最简单途径。

collocations: get to know your professors early
get to know the professor during office hours
encourage students to get to know their professors

words.enDefinition: a public lecture given by a faculty job candidate

examples.en: The candidate's job talk is open to all graduate students.
examples.zh: 这位候选人的「求职讲座」向全体研究生开放。

examples.en: Attend job talks to watch how professors present their research.
examples.zh: 去听「求职讲座」，看看教授们如何展示研究。

words.enDefinition: the polite email opening for a named professor

examples.en: Dear Professor Lee, I hope your semester is going well.
examples.zh: 邮件开头写「Dear Professor」，再加教授的姓氏。

examples.en: Begin every email with Dear Professor rather than just Hi.
examples.zh: 每封邮件都以「Dear Professor」开头，别只写Hi。

words.enDefinition: a common polite email sign-off

examples.en: Close the email with Best regards, then your full name.
examples.zh: 邮件结尾用「Best regards」，再署上全名。

examples.en: Best regards works for most emails you send to professors.
examples.zh: 给教授的多数邮件用「Best regards」落款都可以。

collocations: Best regards followed by your name

words.enDefinition: a formal sign-off word for letters and emails

examples.en: End formal requests to the dean with Sincerely and your full name.
examples.zh: 给院长的正式申请以「Sincerely」加全名结尾。

examples.en: Sincerely sounds much more formal than Cheers in academic emails.
examples.zh: 学术邮件里，「Sincerely」比Cheers更正式。

words.enDefinition: the opening greeting line of a letter or email

examples.en: The salutation sets the tone for your entire email to a professor.
examples.zh: 「称呼语」决定了给教授整封邮件的语气。

examples.en: Choose a formal salutation when emailing a professor for the first time.
examples.zh: 第一次给教授写邮件，要选正式的「称呼语」。

words.enDefinition: a person who greets visitors and answers the phone

examples.en: Tell the receptionist you are here for your two o'clock advising slot.
examples.zh: 告诉「前台接待员」你是来赴两点选课咨询的。

examples.en: The receptionist handed me a form and pointed to the waiting area.
examples.zh: 「接待员」递给我一张表格，指了指等候区。

words.enDefinition: employees who greet and help visitors at a desk

examples.en: The front desk staff can print your enrollment verification letter.
examples.zh: 「前台工作人员」可以帮你打印在读证明。

examples.en: Ask the front desk staff where Professor Lee's office is.
examples.zh: 教授办公室在哪，可以直接问「前台工作人员」。

collocations: front desk staff at the department office

words.enDefinition: a help point with staff who answer campus questions

examples.en: The information desk keeps printed campus maps by the entrance.
examples.zh: 「问询处」在入口处放着纸质校园地图。

examples.en: Ask at the information desk what to do if you lose your student ID.
examples.zh: 学生证丢了，去「问询处」问问该怎么办。

words.enDefinition: to write down a message for someone who is out

examples.en: The professor is teaching right now, but I can take a message.
examples.zh: 教授正在上课，我可以帮你「留言转达」。

examples.en: He asked the receptionist to take a message for Professor Diaz.
examples.zh: 他请接待员替他给迪亚兹教授「留个口信」。

words.enDefinition: a planner where scheduled meetings are written down

examples.en: The receptionist checked the appointment book for a free slot.
examples.zh: 接待员在「预约簿」上找空档。

examples.en: Her appointment book always fills up quickly around midterm week.
examples.zh: 期中周前后，她的「预约簿」总是很快排满。

collocations: sign up in the appointment book

words.enDefinition: a space with seats for visitors who are waiting

examples.en: Please have a seat in the waiting area until the dean calls you.
examples.zh: 请在「等候区」稍坐，院长叫到再进去。

examples.en: The waiting area outside the professor's office has two chairs.
examples.zh: 教授办公室外的「等候区」摆着两把椅子。

words.enDefinition: to return at another time when staff are free

examples.en: The clerk is at lunch, so please come back later.
examples.zh: 办事员去吃午饭了，请「晚点再来」。

examples.en: Forms are processed after three, so come back later today.
examples.zh: 表格三点后才处理，今天「晚点再来」一趟。

collocations: asked me to come back later

words.enDefinition: a person who cleans and maintains a building

examples.en: The janitor unlocks the lecture halls at seven each morning.
examples.zh: 「保洁员」每天早上七点开启教学楼。

examples.en: If you're locked out of the computer lab, find the janitor.
examples.zh: 被锁在机房外面，就去找「保洁员」开门。

words.enDefinition: the workers who clean campus buildings

examples.en: The custodial staff deep-cleans the whole library during spring break.
examples.zh: 春假期间，「保洁团队」会给整个图书馆做深度清洁。

examples.en: Leave the classroom tidy because the custodial staff works overnight.
examples.zh: 教室用完要收拾好，「保洁团队」晚上还要工作。

collocations: report spills to the custodial staff

words.enDefinition: a worker who maintains campus lawns and gardens

examples.en: The groundskeeper replanted the flower beds by the main gate.
examples.zh: 「校园绿化工」在正门边重新种了花坛。

examples.en: Groundskeepers mow the quad early to avoid disturbing class hours.
examples.zh: 「绿化工」一大早修剪草坪，避开上课时间。

words.enDefinition: the campus department that handles safety and lost items

examples.en: Call campus security if you are locked out of the lab at night.
examples.zh: 深夜被锁在实验室外，就打「校园安保」电话。

examples.en: Campus security walks students back to the dorms after late classes.
examples.zh: 晚课后，「校园安保」会护送学生回宿舍。

words.enDefinition: sworn officers with authority on campus property

examples.en: Campus police investigate the bike thefts reported on university property.
examples.zh: 「校警」负责调查校园内报案的自行车失窃。

examples.en: For any emergency on campus, call campus police right away.
examples.zh: 校园里的紧急情况，立刻拨打「校警」电话。

words.enDefinition: a person hired to watch and guard a building

examples.en: The security guard checks student IDs at the library entrance.
examples.zh: 「保安」在图书馆入口查验学生证。

examples.en: Show your ID card to the security guard after midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜后进楼要向「保安」出示证件。

collocations: show your ID to the guard

words.enDefinition: a staffed post where visitors sign in

examples.en: Sign in at the security desk before entering the research wing.
examples.zh: 进研究区前，先在「安保台」登记。

examples.en: Leave your visitor pass at the security desk when you leave.
examples.zh: 离开时，把访客证交回「安保台」。

collocations: sign in at the security desk
check in at the security desk

words.enDefinition: a staff member responsible for workplace safety rules

examples.en: The lab's safety officer runs the annual goggles check every fall.
examples.zh: 实验室的「安全员」每年秋天检查护目镜。

examples.en: Ask the safety officer before storing anything in the fume hood.
examples.zh: 往通风橱里放东西前，先问过「安全员」。

collocations: report hazards to the safety officer

words.enDefinition: the department that fixes campus buildings and rooms

examples.en: Email the facilities office about the broken heater in the seminar room.
examples.zh: 研讨室的暖气坏了，给「后勤设施处」发邮件报修。

examples.en: The facilities office replaced the flickering lights over winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假期间，「后勤处」更换了闪烁的灯管。

collocations: report a problem to the facilities office

words.enDefinition: a request form for maintenance or repairs

examples.en: Submit a work order for the jammed door in the computer lab.
examples.zh: 机房门卡住了，提交一张「维修工单」。

examples.en: The work order status shows the repair is scheduled for Tuesday.
examples.zh: 「工单」状态显示维修定在周二。

words.enDefinition: to connect a caller to another person

examples.en: Hold on please, and I'll put you through to Professor Lee's office.
examples.zh: 请稍等，我帮您「转接」到李教授办公室。

examples.en: The receptionist put me through to the bursar's office directly.
examples.zh: 接待员把我的电话直接「转接」到了财务处。

collocations: put you through to the office

words.enDefinition: the number of students per faculty member at a school

examples.en: A low student-faculty ratio means smaller classes and easier access to professors.
examples.zh: 「师生比」低意味着班级更小，也更容易约到教授。

examples.en: The engineering school advertises a student-faculty ratio of ten to one.
examples.zh: 工学院宣传自己的「师生比」为十比一。

collocations: student-faculty ratio of ten to one

words.enDefinition: a staff member helping a program with admin tasks

examples.en: The program assistant booked the rooms for our poster session.
examples.zh: 「项目助理」为海报展订好了场地。

examples.en: Program assistants process all the forms that professors never see.
examples.zh: 教授从不过目的表格都由「项目助理」处理。

words.enDefinition: an office worker supporting a department's staff

examples.en: The department assistant schedules all the meetings for the professors.
examples.zh: 系里教授们的会议都由「系行政助理」安排。

examples.en: Ask the department assistant for the professor's current office hours.
examples.zh: 教授最新的答疑时间可以问「系行政助理」。

words.enDefinition: the primary office where a department's staff work

examples.en: Hand in the completed form at the main office by Friday.
examples.zh: 填好的表格周五前交到「总办公室」。

examples.en: The main office posts each professor's current weekly office hours.
examples.zh: 「总办公室」会张贴各位教授最新的每周答疑时间。
